title: Eddoboozi Erisirise ery’Ekiwonvu
intro: Ddayo emabega mu biseera eri abantu ab’amaanyi abaali bafuna ekyewuunyo ekiramu ng’ekigezo. Amalala n’obukakanyavu byassaako akabonero ku nkomerero yaabwe. Osobola okulondoola emboozi n’ozuula ekyaliwo mu nkyukakyuka eno ey’ekitalo?
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’okugezesebwa okw’obwakatonda eri abantu ab’amaanyi abamanyiddwa olw’amaanyi gaabwe n’okujeemera.
Nnali kyewuunyo kya njawulo —abalinga nze baali tebalabikangako mu bo.
Nagabana amazzi g’okunywa okuva mu luzzi n’abantu bange ku nnaku ezikyukakyuka.
Baalabulwa nti obulabe bwonna obuntuusibwako bujja kuleeta ekibonerezo eky’amangu.
Abasinga obuvumu ku bo tebaafaayo ku kulabula ne bankuba engalo.
Oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwange, eddoboozi limu ery’okubwatuka eryali liva waggulu lyasaanyaawo abantu bange bonna.
